jobs.description:
As a Capital One Director of Software Engineering, you'll work on everything from customer-facing web and mobile applications using cutting-edge open source frameworks, to highly-available RESTful microservices, to back-end Java based systems and Machine learning models using the hottest techniques in Big Data. You'll bring solid experience in emerging and traditional technologies such as: node.js, Java, GO, AngularJS, React, Python, REST, JSON, XML, Ruby, Perl, NoSQL databases, relational databases, Spark, Artifactory, Maven, iOS, Android, and AWS/Cloud Infrastructure to name a few.

You will:

Lead, manage and grow multiple teams of product focused software engineers
Mentor and guide the professional and technical development of engineers on your team.
Work with product managers to understand desired application capabilities and testing scenarios
Continuously improve software engineering practices
Work within and across Agile teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support technical solutions across a full-stack development tools and technologies
Lead the craftsmanship, availability, resilience, and scalability of your solutions
Bring a passion to stay on top of tech trends, experiment with and learn new technologies, participate in internal & external technology communities, and mentor other members of the engineering community
Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, inclusion, outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity
Work across to improve the velocity of your and other teams
Lead efforts to deploy new and existing applications into AWS environments
Break existing monolithic applications into micro service architectures and build new microservices

:

Bachelor’s Degree
At least 7 years’ experience in software development
At least 5 years’ experience in people management

Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a Master’s Degree in Software Engineering
10+ years’ of experience in software development

jobs.description:
Engineering Director – MEP Engineering, Design-Build & Energy

Location | Capital Region, New York Metropolitan Area (On-site)

Our client is an established engineering, construction management, and design-build organization delivering complex building infrastructure, MEP, energy efficiency, and modernization projects across healthcare, higher education, institutional, commercial, and public-sector environments.

They are seeking an experienced Engineering Director to lead a multidisciplinary engineering team while providing technical leadership, project oversight, resource planning, and senior-level client leadership across complex MEP, energy, and infrastructure projects.

Working directly with the President and senior leadership, this individual will play an important role in connecting engineering with construction and overall project delivery while helping shape the continued development of the engineering organization.

This is a significant leadership opportunity for an accomplished engineering professional who wants to move beyond traditional department management and build toward broader organizational leadership over time.

Overview

The Engineering Director will lead an established team of approximately 10 to 15 engineering professionals supporting technically complex projects involving electrical and mechanical infrastructure, HVAC systems, central plants, building controls, electrification, lighting, energy efficiency, decarbonization, and multidisciplinary MEP systems.

This individual will oversee engineering quality, staffing, budgets, schedules, technical decision-making, team development, and project execution while working closely with construction management, project leadership, clients, and company executives.

The successful candidate does not need to personally perform every aspect of engineering production. The organization is looking for a leader who can provide technical credibility and direction while maintaining a broader view of project delivery, people, clients, and the business.

Candidates may come from either an Electrical or Mechanical Engineering background, with multidisciplinary MEP/building systems experience strongly valued.

What You'll Lead

Lead, mentor, and further develop a multidisciplinary engineering team.
Provide leadership across electrical, mechanical, MEP, energy, and building infrastructure projects.
Oversee engineering quality, project priorities, staffing, resource allocation, budgets, schedules, and deliverables.
Provide technical direction across building electrical systems, HVAC, central plants, BAS/BMS, controls, electrification, lighting, energy efficiency, and infrastructure modernization.
Participate in project planning, design reviews, constructability discussions, estimating, technical decision-making, and risk mitigation.
Work closely with construction management and project leadership to ensure engineering solutions support successful project execution.
Serve as a senior technical and client-facing resource on complex projects and key accounts.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
Develop engineering standards, processes, and best practices that support quality and efficient project delivery.
Support recruiting, mentoring, retention, and professional development across the engineering organization.
Work directly with the President and senior leadership on engineering strategy, organizational development, and future growth.
Help strengthen the integration of engineering, construction, and project delivery across the organization.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Significant progressive experience within MEP engineering, building systems, energy, design-build, or related engineering environments.
Proven experience leading engineers, technical teams, projects, or engineering functions.
Strong understanding of multidisciplinary building systems, including electrical and mechanical infrastructure.
Experience with complex commercial, healthcare, higher education, institutional, or public-sector facilities.
Experience working within design-build, construction management, or integrated engineering/construction environments strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to oversee project budgets, schedules, staffing, resources, technical quality, and risk.
Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills.
Ability to provide credible technical leadership without needing to personally perform all engineering production.
Experience with healthcare and/or higher education facilities is highly valued.
Professional Engineer (PE) registration is highly preferred. Exceptional candidates with appropriate technical and leadership experience may also be considered.

Location

Position is based in the Capital Region of New York.
This is primarily an office-based leadership position with regular interaction across engineering, project management, construction, and senior leadership.
Periodic travel may be required for client meetings, project sites, and other company locations.
Relocation assistance may be available for the right candidate.

Why This Opportunity

Lead an established multidisciplinary engineering organization.
Work directly with the President and senior company leadership.
Influence engineering strategy, project delivery, team development, and organizational growth.
Work across engineering, construction management, and design-build project delivery rather than operating within an isolated engineering function.
Take on a highly visible leadership role with meaningful client and business exposure.
Build toward broader organizational and executive leadership as credibility and responsibility grow within the company.

The Texas Water Company
is actively seeking talented, driven and highly-productive applicants for the position of Sr Director of Engineering to join our dynamic team. We offer a challenging and rewarding work environment along with a competitive salary and an excellent benefits package.  

Position Overview:

This role is responsible for leading the engineering function by overseeing planning, design, and construction activities for water infrastructure and capital improvement programs. This role ensures programs are delivered on time, on budget, and in compliance with regulatory, safety, and quality standards. They direct multiple teams and leaders, while aligning stakeholders, vendors, and partners to drive effective program execution. This role oversees capital planning, budgeting, governance, and performance monitoring while establishing engineering standards and driving continuous improvement initiatives. They drive strategic direction for long term infrastructure investment, system reliability, and operational sustainability. They lead continuous improvement efforts and advance initiatives that improve service delivery and asset performance. Success in this role requires strong executive leadership, deep technical expertise in civil and water infrastructure, as well as advanced program management and communication skills to drive operational excellence. 

Key Responsibilities:

Provides strategic leadership and overall direction for engineering planning, design, and construction activities supporting water infrastructure and capital improvement programs. Ensures alignment with organizational priorities, regulatory requirements, and long-term system needs. 
Oversees and directs multiple engineering teams and leaders responsible for project delivery, design, construction, and inspection activities. Establishes organizational structure, assigns program level resources, and ensures effective execution across all engineering functions. 
Established departmental goals, priorities, and policies in alignment with senior leadership. Leads long term strategic planning (e.g. capital improvement programming, infrastructure investment, system reliability initiatives).
Provides oversight of the full lifecycle of engineering programs and projects to ensure delivery is consistent, compliant, and in alignment with project scope, schedule, and budget.
Leads development, administration, and execution of the capital improvement program, including prioritization of projects, allocation of funding, and interdepartmental coordination (e.g. operations, finance, senior leadership).
Oversees the development and management of engineering an capital budgets, forecasts, and financial plans. Ensures fiscal responsibility, cost control, and long-term financial sustainability of infrastructure programs. • Establishes and enforces engineering standards, methodologies, and governance to ensure consistency, quality, and regulatory compliance. 
Provides technical oversight and services as the final authority on complex engineering decisions, design standards, and infrastructure strategies. Reviews and approves significant engineering plans, specifications, and capital projects. 
Oversees construction, inspection, and field operations related to engineering projects. Ensures risks, issues, and critical path activities are appropriately escalated, managed, and resolved.
Directs coordination external agencies and stakeholders to ensure compliance. Builds and maintains relationships with internal teams, vendors, and external stakeholders.
Oversees developer and new service programs to ensure consistent process, service delivery, and alignment with strategic goals.
Leads and supports staff development including leadership development and performance management. 
Represents the department at internal meetings, regulatory hearings, and stakeholder engagements. 
Provides oversight of reporting, performance metrics, and analytics for engineering programs. Communicates program performance, risks, and strategic insights to executive leadership. 
Leads continuous improvement initiatives (e.g. process optimization, system implementations, and adoptions of new technologies). 
Ensures compliance with all regulatory, safety, and organizational policies. Promotes culture of safety, accountability, and operational excellence across engineering and construction activities. • Participates in audit processes, compliance reviews, and regulatory reporting at the organizational level. Ensures documentation, controls, and processes meet both internal controls and external regulatory requirements. 
Provides leadership support during emergency response situations and critical infrastructure events to ensure effective organizational response.
Required to complete occasional evening and weekend work to meet deadlines or address emergencies as needed.
Performs other duties or special projects as required or assigned.

Experience leading the work of teams and employees engaged in engineering projects and construction, preferred.

Technology at Huge is powered by a global practice of creative technologists—spanning Engineers, QA specialists, Business Analysts, Data Scientists, and ML Architects—we look beyond standard patterns to build resilient, enterprise-grade systems. We combine deep engineering rigor with innovation at the edge of agentic AI, modern data stacks, and cloud infrastructure. We don't wait for industry standards to set themselves; we engineer the intelligent systems that turn audacious strategic vision into production-ready reality.

Huge is looking for a Director of Technology to join the global technology team. The ideal candidate possesses a wide range of technical knowledge across multiple systems and solution types. Someone who understands client business challenges and partners with clients and other disciplines at Huge to design transformative experiences and identify technology solutions to enable them.

Collaborate with clients to understand their technology needs, recommend solutions, and establish strong client relationships.
Develop and execute a technology strategy that aligns with business objectives and drives innovation.

Identify and mitigate technology-related risks, ensuring security and compliance with industry standards.

Dedication to evolving the technology practice, developing materials and content for internal initiatives, and leading them.

We partner with commercial, civil, and national security customers to deliver high-performance satellite components, integrated payload systems, and mission capabilities that close critical gaps in modern space architecture.

Our model combines advanced engineering, mission execution, and scalable manufacturing to deliver high-TRL products and flight-ready systems at speed.

We are building the infrastructure backbone for the next generation of space systems.

Partner with other ML leaders (Growth , Edge deployment) and cross-functional leaders in Hardware, Platform, and Product engineering to align development roadmaps

5+ years of experience in leadership and management, ideally having managed other managers
MS or PhD in computer science and/or a quantitative discipline

Manage large scale datasets and database tools for data processing

Operate in innovative, high-growth environments

jobs.description:
What We Do

At Leading Educators (LE)
, we know that excellent teaching is the most important driver of student success. The moment a student steps foot in the classroom, their opportunity to learn depends on how prepared their teacher is to translate complex content knowledge, standards, and their knowledge of that student into lessons that help them learn deeply and apply their thinking to the real world.
That’s a big lift, and it often happens alone. As a national nonprofit, we partner with school systems to overcome persistent instructional challenges, foster intentional collaboration and adult learning by design, and ignite new possibilities through systemic solutions at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology.
We work shoulder-to-shoulder with educators at every level of the education system to strengthen their instructional and leadership practices, bring a vision for excellent instruction to life with consistency, and ensure every student reaches their full potential.
Through direct support, strategic advising, innovation pilots, and best-in-class research, we help educators work toward a future where every student is ready to thrive. Learn more about our work at leadingeducators.org.
Internal Candidate Application Deadline:
9/8/2026

External Candidate Application Deadline:
9/11/2026

Position

As Leading Educators' senior technology leader, you will shape and execute the organization's technology vision and strategy in direct support of our mission to ensure every student succeeds in school and in life. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you'll provide strategic leadership across technology strategy, systems and security, AI governance, organizational technology adoption, and technology operations—driving decisions that enable educators to focus on what they do best: teaching.
This is a role of significant influence and impact. You won't just manage infrastructure; you'll architect the technology ecosystem that empowers our team to work shoulder-to-shoulder with school systems to overcome instructional challenges, foster collaboration, and ignite new possibilities at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology. Every decision you make will ripple through our organization and ultimately support students' success.
Leading a small, talented technology team, you'll ensure that LE's technology investments are secure, scalable, sustainable, and—most importantly—effectively adopted across the organization. You'll build organizational capacity to translate technology investments into everyday practices that drive real results. This is an opportunity to lead with vision, mentor emerging talent, and demonstrate how strategic technology leadership advances educational excellence.
Do you have expertise in…

Developing and executing multi-year technology roadmaps that align IT strategy with organizational priorities, scalability, and long-term sustainability?

Leading technology transformation and modernization initiatives across complex organizations, including managing change, building adoption, and ensuring staff readiness?

Establishing governance frameworks and policies for responsible AI adoption, data protection, cybersecurity, and organizational risk management?

Managing technology vendors, budgets, and investments while maximizing value and ensuring quality service delivery?

Do you enjoy…

Translating complex technical concepts and strategic decisions into clear, compelling language for nontechnical leaders and stakeholders?

Building and developing high-performing teams, supporting professional growth, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and accountability?

Bridges technical solutions with organizational strategy and culture, ensuring technology serves people, mission, and organizational priorities rather than the reverse. 

Taking on strategic challenges that require both deep technical expertise and thoughtful change leadership?

If you've answered affirmatively to these questions and meet the following prerequisites, we urge you to seize this opportunity. This role calls for the following:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field and 10+ years of progressive experience in technology, IT, enterprise systems, digital transformation, or related areas

Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategy and multi-year roadmaps aligned with organizational priorities

Proven track record leading technology transformation, modernization, or systems change across an organization, including successful change management and adoption

Experience leading AI enablement, adoption, or governance within an organization, with the ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into responsible organizational use

Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity, data protection, enterprise systems, technology risk, and governance, with the ability to provide strategic oversight of these areas

Experience developing and governing organizational technology policies and standards, including responsible AI use, data governance, and technology risk

You will be focused on scaling networking products within hyperscale or high-performance computing environments designed for AI. Key Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Execution: Lead the 0-to-1 growth lifecycle to ensure alignment with AI Connect revenue objectives. Drive product-market fit from initial market mapping and target identification through commercial launch and active revenue expansion.
Data-Driven Market Growth: Conduct thorough analysis of the AI infrastructure landscape, including data center construction pipelines, power availability, GPU deployment trends, fiber route economics, and interconnection dynamics. Leverage these insights to optimize the product go-to-market funnel, inform growth strategy, and prioritize high-value segments.
Ecosystem Product Strategy: Define and manage the growth roadmap across hyperscalers, data center and colocation operators, real estate partners, OEMs, and emerging AI infrastructure companies. Identify product white space to build scalable solutions that convert Verizon's fiber footprint, optical services portfolio, and AI-ready facilities into recurring infrastructure revenue.
Growth Modeling & Commercialization: Develop scalable commercial models spanning optical and fiber-based services, such as Wavelength Services (10G/100G/400G+), optical extensions, programmable network fabric, data center interconnection, and AI-ready facility partnerships. Establish pricing constructs, capacity commitments, and route-specific terms optimized for rapid market adoption and platform stickiness.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with Product, Network Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Sales teams to shape offers and deal terms, and to ensure seamless execution from signature through delivery.
Stakeholder Management: Communicate effectively and manage expectations with business sponsors, company executives, external partners, and customers, acting as a credible and technically fluent representative of Verizon AI Connect at the most senior levels.

Stay ahead of the curve on emerging AI infrastructure trends to keep Verizon's strategy competitive.
Business Strategy: Define partnership business models, pricing strategies, target segments, execution plans, and financial business cases for AI Infrastructure and Networking opportunities.
Content Creation: Develop compelling partner-facing collateral, business cases, and executive presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Six or more years of relevant experience in technology and/or telecommunications.
Demonstrated understanding of the AI infrastructure market, including fiber networks and optical services, data centers, colocation, and interconnection.
Experience originating, structuring, negotiating, and closing large, complex, multi-year commercial or partnership agreements — from inception to signing.
Experience with business models and/or business cases for infrastructure or connectivity services.
Experience with Business-to-Business partnerships, enterprise sales, or corporate development.
Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

Data Quality & Governance: Establish standard governance models, define single-source-of-truth unified metric definitions, and drive high data quality across customer lifecycle touchpoints
Documentation & Discoverability: Improve data documentation, architecture transparency, and platform discoverability across teams
Value Measurement & Lifecycle Management: Measure the business value of data products, managing data tools and platforms through their end-to-end lifecycle

Reliability & Data Contracts: Establish data contracts and SLAs for critical datasets, defining freshness, availability, and reliability standards that consumers and downstream AI systems can depend on
Trust, Privacy & Compliance: Safeguard sensitive and customer data through robust access controls, privacy, and regulatory compliance, ensuring the data foundation is secure and trusted by design
Data Literacy & Adoption: Drive data literacy and change management across the organization so teams confidently adopt and act on data products rather than simply receive them
AI & Agent Enablement: Build and govern the AI-ready data foundation that powers net-new AI agents, and define, curate, and maintain the library of agent skills and actions that let those agents take trusted, automated action across the customer lifecycle

8–12+ years in Data Product Management, Data Strategy, Analytics, or Enterprise Governance, with a track record of driving data capabilities at scale.
Strong analytical and technical acumen, with a demonstrated ability to evaluate complex data architectures and lead central data functions across functional boundaries.
Deep familiarity with the Salesforce product ecosystem, architectures, and integrated data and analytics capabilities.
Proven track record in data governance and metric alignment, including defining single-source-of-truth frameworks and establishing high data quality across the customer lifecycle.
Strong product lifecycle management skills, with the ability to assess, build, extend, and manage value-driven data products and platforms.
Proven ability to leverage data, analytics, and platform capabilities to solve real business scaling challenges, eliminating fragmented spreadsheets and manual tracking.
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across Product, Tech, Operations, Finance, and GTM teams.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, with a proven capability to articulate data strategies and translate complex metrics into clear, actionable business insights.
Ability to succeed in a collaborative, fast-paced environment; flexible and capable of adjusting on the fly to evolving business demands with a strong sense of urgency.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, transitioning team practices from reactive reporting to proactive operational insights.
Experience in high-growth enterprise, SaaS, or complex ecosystem environments preferred.

As a member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects that make a real difference in people's lives. We're looking for talented individuals who are passionate about our mission and share our values of commitment, respect, excellence, accountability, and collaboration.

Role Summary:

The Senior Director, Technology Operations is a key member of the Information Technology leadership team responsible for leading CPC's enterprise technology operations and ensuring the delivery of secure, reliable, and high-performing technology services that enable the organization's mission and business objectives.

Reporting directly to the CIO, this role provides strategic and operational leadership across IT Service Management (ITSM), End User Services, Infrastructure, Networks, Cloud Operations, Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity Operations, Technology Engineering, and Vendor Management. The Senior Director is responsible for establishing operational excellence through modern service management practices, process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement while delivering exceptional employee technology experience.

The ideal candidate is an experienced, customer-focused technology leader with a passion for building high-performing teams, developing operational capabilities, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and service excellence. This individual will partner closely with business leaders and strategic technology partners to modernize CPC's technology operations, strengthen cybersecurity, improve operational resilience, and support the organization's continued growth and digital transformation.

Leadership & Organizational Excellence

Build, lead, and continuously evolve a world-class Technology Operations organization that delivers exceptional customer experience, operational excellence, and business value.
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of IT professionals through coaching, performance management, training, succession planning, and career development.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centric service delivery.
Develop organizational capabilities, operating procedures, and service standards that enable scalable growth and operational maturity.

Technology Operations Strategy & Governance

Develop and execute CPC's Technology Operations strategy and roadmap in alignment with the overall IT strategy and business objectives.
Establish and mature IT Service Management (ITSM) capabilities based on ITIL best practices, including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Configuration, Knowledge, Request, and Service Level Management.
Define operational KPIs, SLAs, dashboards, and executive reporting to measure service performance, operational effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.
Drive continuous service improvement initiatives through automation, process optimization, standardization, and operational governance.

Enterprise Technology Operations

Provide strategic leadership for enterprise technology operations supporting CPC headquarters and regional offices, ensuring highly available, secure, resilient, and reliable technology services.
Oversee End User Computing, Service Desk, Infrastructure, Networks, Cloud Services, Endpoint Management, Identity & Access Management, Operational Cybersecurity, and enterprise technology support.
Ensure operational readiness, business continuity, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and technology lifecycle management across the enterprise.
Lead operational planning to support future business growth, modernization initiatives, and evolving technology requirements.

Technology Service Delivery

Ensure the delivery of reliable, secure, and customer-focused technology services that consistently meet or exceed established service levels.
Continuously improve the IT service portfolio, end-user experience, and operational efficiency through service optimization and automation.
Partner with business leaders to understand operational needs and translate them into scalable technology solutions.
Establish a service-oriented culture focused on responsiveness, transparency, communication, and measurable business outcomes.

Program & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight for Technology Operations projects, ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.
Prioritize operational initiatives and technology investments that improve reliability, security, scalability, and user experience.
Collaborate with the PMO and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise technology initiatives that support CPC's strategic objectives.
Sponsor and champion continuous improvement initiatives that increase operational maturity and reduce technology risk.

Vendor & Strategic Partner Management

Develop and manage strategic relationships with Managed Service Providers (MSPs), technology vendors, cloud providers, and external partners.
Establish vendor governance processes, performance metrics, service reviews, and contractual accountability to ensure delivery of high-quality services.
Lead vendor selection activities, including RFI, RFP, RFQ, contract negotiations, and ongoing performance management.
Optimize vendor relationships to maximize value, control costs, reduce operational risk, and support CPC's long-term technology strategy.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

Partner with vendor’s leadership to ensure operational security controls, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and infrastructure security are effectively implemented.
Support enterprise cybersecurity, compliance, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives through operational excellence and technology governance.
Promote a security-first culture across technology operations while ensuring reliable and resilient service delivery.

15+ years of progressive experience in Information Technology, including leadership of enterprise IT Operations, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Engineering, and Service Delivery.
Proven experience building, leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing IT teams with a strong customer service focus.
Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences while driving operational excellence and continuous process improvement.

Ecosystem Product Strategy: Define and manage the growth roadmap across hyperscalers, data center and colocation operators, real estate partners, OEMs, and emerging AI infrastructure companies. Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.

Data Quality & Governance: Establish standard governance models, define single-source-of-truth unified metric definitions, and drive high data quality across customer lifecycle touchpoints
